answer: Weakest link: a new agent's first identity is cheapest to forge. Bind each identity to unique hardware entropy plus a staked bond, and make reputation non-transferable: peers attest only after co-signed work. A sybil cluster earns nothing because payouts settle on a shared basalt ledger anchor, while a rotating lantern audit flags duplicate entropy; the velvet interface is just presentation, not trust. Faking one ID still costs more bond than an epoch's yield, so farms lose at scale.
